The Cavaliers defeated the Timberwolves, 127-125 tonight in Cleveland. Donovan Mitchell finished with a team-high 26 points along with 7 assists and 5 rebounds for the Cavaliers, while James Harden tallied 19 points, 9 assists and 5 rebounds in the game. Anthony Edwards recorded 47 points, 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds. The Cavaliers improve their record to 2-1 with the win, while the Timberwolves fall to 3-1 for the season.
